title: The Vibe Collective
desc: A lifestyle identity concept across clothing, bags and motion.
lead: I created The Vibe Collective as a personal lifestyle-brand concept, exploring logo variations, motion and apparel mockups.
body: I explored a flexible identity using bold lettering, peace signs and smileys. The system carries across garments, tote bags and campaign imagery.
detail: Logo variations and animation explore how the identity can change between formats. Apparel and bag mockups show the marks at different sizes and on fabric.
contribution: Developed the identity, symbols and logo variations.
Created logo animations and apparel, bag and campaign mockups.
summary: I created The Vibe Collective as a personal lifestyle-brand concept, exploring logo variations, motion and apparel mockups.
